name: Charlotte Katakuri
effect:
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When a DON!! card on your field is returned to your DON!! deck, if your Leader has the {Big Mom Pirates} type, add up to 2 DON!! cards from your DON!! deck and rest them.
[On K.O.] Play up to 1 Character card with 8000 power or less from your hand.

official_faq.question: Imagine that I have two "ST34-001 Charlotte Katakuri" and 10 DON!! cards on my field during my turn. I return 1 DON!! card to my DON!! deck, and activate the effect of one of my "ST34-001 Charlotte Katakuri" to add 1 DON!! card from my DON!! deck and rest it. Can I then use another card's effect to return 1 of the DON!! cards on my field to my DON!! deck, activate the effect of the other "ST34-001 Charlotte Katakuri", and add 1 more DON!! card from my DON!! deck and rest it?
